BiblicalUsage: Daniel's fourth kingdom is strong as iron and breaks all in pieces, the fourth man walking in the furnace was like the Son of God, and the fourth beast was dreadful and terrible and exceedingly strong.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the fourth of everything in Daniel is where God shows that He, not the kingdoms, has the last word.
